exposure: anterior transposition of the cardinal ligaments
outcome: patient satisfaction regarding self-assessment of gynecologic anatomy
cohort: Two patients with POP quantification Stages II-III uterine prolapse who declined hysterectomy or amputation of the cervix.
finding: Both patients who underwent anterior transposition of the cardinal ligaments for uterine prolapse reported no undue pain or dyspareunia, complete satisfaction with self-assessment of gynecologic anatomy, and satisfactory anatomic correction at 18-month follow-up.
